bug_semantics: Reflected XSS in the Tainacan WordPress plugin taxonomy-archive search form: tainacan_get_taxonomies_search() reads the public WP query var 'search' (from the unauthenticated GET parameter of the same name via Theme_Helper::get_taxonomies_query_args()) and echoes $current_args['search'] into an HTML value="..." attribute with no escaping. A crafted URL such as ?search="><script>... breaks out of the input and executes in a victim browser after a click. The later hidden-input loop over other $_GET keys explicitly skips 'search', so this CVE's named parameter is that attribute sink. Affected through 1.0.0; 1.0.1 wraps the value in esc_attr().
flaw_origin: The unescaped attribute write was first authored on 2023-02-24 in 8a01249afd463b57fa9ad8246fe2eacebb94a91b ('Adds children links to terms list. #758.'), which introduced tainacan_get_taxonomies_search() with value="<?php echo $current_args['search']; ?>", wired search into get_taxonomies_query_args() via get_query_var('search', ''), and concatenated the form onto taxonomy-post content. Immediate parent fc308b84d39281bbc22c8b4bdb1a607ce069c9b8 has neither the function nor any echo of current_args['search']. Later #758 edits only retitled IDs/labels and added other GET hidden fields; they did not first write this sink.

evidence: CVE.org/Wordfence CNA CVE-2025-12746 and GHSA-37g4-vx3r-j5q5 (withdrawn_at null) describe reflected XSS via the 'search' parameter in Tainacan <= 1.0.0 (CWE-79, CVSS 6.1); Wordfence remediation is 1.0.1. Not withdrawn/rejected.

Advisory blob https://github.com/tainacan/tainacan/blob/2491612ee9d5b14baa70862ba2308ee925de0938/src/classes/theme-helper/template-tags.php#L1652 is tainacan_get_taxonomies_search at parent of the fix; line 1681 is value="<?php echo $current_args['search']; ?>" and lines 1689-1695 skip 'search' when copying other $_GET keys into hidden inputs.

Parent is 2491612ee9d5b14baa70862ba2308ee925de0938. Same change is wordpress.org plugin changeset 3395909.

Same commit also adds $current_search = get_query_var('search', '') in class-tainacan-theme-helper.php get_taxonomies_query_args() and $content .= tainacan_get_taxonomies_search() on taxonomy post types.

WordPress core WP::$public_query_vars includes 'search', so GET ?search= is populated by get_query_var('search') without HTML escaping; the form method=get name=search is reachable unauthenticated on taxonomy archive pages that call tainacan_get_taxonomies_search().
